title: Chapter 6: Union Executive – President, Vice President, Prime Minister and Council of Ministers

blocks.content: Articles 52 to 78 of the Indian Constitution deal with the Union Executive.
Articles 52 to 78 of the Indian Constitution deal with the Union Executive.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 52 to 78 of Part V of the Indian Constitution deal with the Union Executive.
The Union Executive consists of five distinct components: the President, Vice President, Prime Minister, Council of Ministers, and the Attorney General of India.
The Attorney General of India is constitutionally included as part of the Union Executive.
Remember that the Attorney General of India is part of the Union Executive (a common trick question in UPSC Prelims).
Articles 52 through 78 explicitly define the composition and powers of the Union Executive.

blocks.content:
The Union Executive consists of:
• President
• Vice President
• Prime Minister
• Council of Ministers
• Attorney General of India
